            total_rate = [0.0] * (1 << n)

                i = bit.bit_length() - 1
                previous = mask ^ bit

                total_rate[mask] = total_rate[previous] + rate[i]

                rows, cols, data = [], [], []

                            cols.append(j)

                    cols.append(j)

                    np.r_[np.ones(n), float(gpu_num), np.zeros(count)],
